intro: Remittances, farming and fishing support Tonga's economy.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Money from Tongans abroad is a large share of the economy. Squash, vanilla and root crops are exported, and whale watching brings tourists.

chapters.title: Recovery
text: The 2022 eruption damaged crops and cut the undersea internet cable for weeks.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Tonga makes and sells to the world.
